lines.rom: prapitamaha haim svayam vidhata pulista vamsa ke janma vikhyata
visrava pita idavida ji mata vibhisana bhagata apake bhrata
siva caranom mem jaba dhyana lagaya ghora tapasya kari tana ko sukhaya
siva varadana mile devatya paya amrta pana kari amara hui kaya
dharma dhvaja sada lie hatha mem devi devata saba phiraim satha mem
pitambara vastra pahane gata mem bala sakti puri yaksa jata mem
svarna simhasana apa virajaim trisula gada hatha mem sajaim
samkha mrdamga nagare bajaim gamdharva raga madhura svara gajaim
caumsatha yogani mamgala gavaim rddhi siddhi nita bhoga lagavaim
dasa dasani sira chatra phiravaim yaksa yaksani mila camvara dhulavaim
rsiyom mem jaise parasurama bali haim devanha mem jaise hanumana bali haim
purusom mem jaise bhima bali haim yaksom mem aise hi kubera bali haim
